title: Standalone OBJECTCONTEXTDATA adapter loss/refusal fast slice
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Prevent the concrete dwg2dxf adapter from silently publishing DXF when standalone DWG OBJECTCONTEXTDATA callbacks would be discarded.

changes.typedCallback: addObjectContextData sets a sticky standaloneObjectContextDataPresent marker.
changes.rawCallback: addUnsupportedObject detects OBJECTCONTEXTDATA in record/class names without allocating and sets the same marker; it does not label the raw frame as retained.
changes.exportBehavior: fileExport emits an explicit incomplete-output diagnostic and refuses before opening or replacing the destination whenever the marker is set.

producerTraceSweep.conversionDisposition: All ten reads succeeded, but strict-complete conversion stopped at the existing complete-DWG-read preflight; the failures do not establish context-object behavior.
producerTraceSweep.evidenceCeiling: No producer-authored context object or conflicting base-bit profile was observed; ODA remains canonical and producer compatibility remains unresolved.

mleaderPayloadReadinessAudit.odaRootSequence: Lists B 290, B 291, 3BD connection point, 3BD direction, then break count; the table does not show IF guards on either coordinate.
mleaderPayloadReadinessAudit.localEmbeddedDecoder: parseMLeaderRoot reads the connection point only when flag 290 is true and direction only when flag 291 is true; its source comment cites LibreDWG dwg2.spec.
mleaderPayloadReadinessAudit.implementationDecision: Do not reuse the embedded parser for standalone contexts or change conditional behavior without reconciling the complete ODA text and obtaining an eligible producer trace/source-authored stream.

relatedBroaderSelector.failure: TABLE -> TABLESTYLE dictionary/carrier references diverged before the new context-loss control was reached.
relatedBroaderSelector.scope: Separate worktree failure; not used as acceptance for this slice.
